resources.string: Uses your Google Drive to keep your place in films and episodes the same on all your TVs

Sign in with the same Google account on each TV. MyTVPlayer keeps where you got to in films and episodes in a hidden folder in your Google Drive. Only MyTVPlayer can see that folder, and it reads nothing else in your Drive.
On your phone or computer, go to %1$s and enter this code:
Waiting for you to sign in…
The code ran out of time. Try again.
Couldn\'t reach Google. Check the connection and try again.
Deletes this TV\'s copy in your Google Drive. What you watched on this TV stays here.
